TaskDescription: Within-subject, randomized-order cue-based left- vs right-hand motor imagery of a bimanual rowing task, compared across Graz and NeuRow virtual-reality conditions with optional haptic and head-mounted-display feedback, plus a motor-execution control. Trial duration: 5.0s, imagery: 5.0s.
Instructions: Imagine moving the left or right paddle (bimanual rowing) following the directional cue.
InstitutionName: Instituto Superior Tecnico, Universidade de Lisboa
Description: Motor-imagery EEG plus PPG, respiration, ECG and accelerometry from 20 healthy volunteers performing cued left/right-hand motor imagery of a rowing task during VR/haptics BCI training.
